interviewcake_bst-checker.incorrectReason: Checks only immediate children and misses ordering restrictions inherited from more distant ancestors.

interviewcake_bracket-validator.incorrectReason: Counts delimiters without tracking types, accepting mismatched or crossing pairs.

interviewcake_cafe-order-checker.incorrectReason: Checks membership and counts but ignores order within each source queue.

interviewcake_nth-fibonacci.incorrectReason: Uses one-based seed values and computes F(n+1) instead of F(n).

interviewcake_delete-node.incorrectReason: Bypasses the successor without copying its value, deleting the wrong logical position.

interviewcake_linked-list-cycles.incorrectReason: Uses payload equality instead of node identity, misclassifying repeated values in a finite list.

interviewcake_find-duplicate-files.incorrectReason: Inspects only top-level files, missing duplicates in nested directories; also silently replaces approximate matching with exact bytes.

interviewcake_highest-product-of-3.incorrectReason: Selects the three greatest values and misses products formed by two large-magnitude negatives.

interviewcake_queue-two-stacks.incorrectReason: Pops from the incoming stack and produces LIFO rather than FIFO order.

interviewcake_shuffle.incorrectReason: Excludes retaining the current occurrence, so not all permutations are possible.

interviewcake_inflight-entertainment.incorrectReason: Allows the same array position to serve as both movies.

interviewcake_kth-to-last-node-in-singly.incorrectReason: Computes the right payload but returns a new node rather than the required original object identity.

interviewcake_largest-stack.incorrectReason: Stores a maximum only on strict increase, losing remaining copies when one repeated maximum is popped.

interviewcake_coin.incorrectReason: Reverses the dynamic-programming loops and counts ordered sequences instead of unordered combinations.

interviewcake_merge-sorted-arrays.incorrectReason: Removes repeated values instead of preserving every input occurrence.

interviewcake_merging-ranges.incorrectReason: Treats touching endpoints as separate ranges instead of condensing their union.

interviewcake_mesh-message.incorrectReason: Returns the first depth-first route, which can be longer than a minimum-edge route.

interviewcake_compress-url-list.incorrectReason: Confuses an existing prefix with a complete inserted key; has no terminal marker.

interviewcake_matching-parens.incorrectReason: Returns the first closer without accounting for nested openers.

interviewcake_permutation-palindrome.incorrectReason: Rejects every valid odd-length palindrome permutation with one odd-frequency character.

interviewcake_product-of-other-numbers.incorrectReason: Uses division and loses the nonzero product at a single zero position.

interviewcake_rectangular-love.incorrectReason: Computes the bounding union box instead of the positive-area intersection.

interviewcake_recursive-string-permutati.incorrectReason: Recurses but inserts the first character in only one position, omitting most permutations.

interviewcake_reverse-linked-list.incorrectReason: Builds new nodes with reversed values instead of reusing and rewiring the original nodes.

interviewcake_reverse-string-in-place.incorrectReason: Reassigns the local parameter to a new array and leaves the caller array unchanged.

interviewcake_reverse-words.incorrectReason: Reverses characters globally without restoring each word's internal order.

interviewcake_simulate-5-sided-die.incorrectReason: Maps seven equally likely states modulo five, biasing two output values.

interviewcake_simulate-7-sided-die.incorrectReason: Maps all twenty-five equiprobable states modulo seven instead of rejecting the last four.

interviewcake_temperature-tracker.incorrectReason: Uses the maximum for both extrema, failing after distinct temperature insertions.

interviewcake_cake-thief.incorrectReason: Solves zero-or-one knapsack instead of allowing unlimited copies, and misses the unbounded zero-weight case.

interviewcake_find-unique-int-among-dupl.incorrectReason: Uses numeric-sum parity rather than cancellation by bitwise XOR, losing the unique identifier.

interviewcake_top-scores.incorrectReason: Sorts scores in ascending rather than nonincreasing order.

interviewcake_which-appears-twice.incorrectReason: Uses array length instead of range upper bound n=length-1 in the arithmetic-series subtraction.
